SelectedOriginalQpcWindows.Meaning: All >=100 ms application/probe intervals, each timer maximum, first focus/keyboard and every native dialogue initialisation. Native rows only are clipped; no acceptance sample is filtered.

NativeMetadata.Meaning: Scheduling/stacks from a separately profiled execution, not acceptance. Missing/unresolved symbols and runtime events remain missing; overlap is not causality.

Limits: Window-edge/missing pairs remain unassigned. Off-CPU includes normal waits, not necessarily a fault. Ready-to-running requires an observed Ready state/event. Native ancestors are not exclusive/self CPU or identities of unresolved managed callbacks. No runtime GC/suspension coverage is inferred from zero captured CLR events. Profiling overhead is outside acceptance.
